text:
Long post alert! 
For BMD students,
Faculty reviews for the courses I did in 261 (no sugarcoating and sweet talks)
Mic201-MSIM
Sir is decent, but unar class RA 8 am e thakay, most of the students were half asleep and didn’t gave a shit about what he said. He yaps a lot about all the experiences he had and talks in depth about the topics (which may seem irrelevant sometimes). The worst part is uni pura 1.5 hour class nei and sometimes even crosses that too. It sucked for me cause amr por por 2 ta class thakay, coffee khawar time o paitam nah barely. About his questions, he takes best 2/3 quizzes and the quizzes are easy just ek dui ta questions ektu ghurano dei like u will be confused those jate full marks ta keo easily nah pay rki. Quizzes are mainly mcq and tf. And he will take one mid term and there will broad questions and a set of quiz. All of the exams are only from the slides. But he doesn’t give marks generously for the theoretical questions in midterm and finals. In fact, onk marks kate bhai, tmi nije dekheo shocked hoye jaba je eto bhalo likha r por o kmne marks katlo. Literally mid e 25.9 dse, and ei .1 number o curve kore dei nai. Like he gives marks very weirdly. And about his slides, short and concise e hoy but onkkkk infos, plus uni mid r final er syllabus onk boro dei. Literally he gave 13 fucking lectures for finals and shb gula te eto infos chilo je, you might even start hallucinate in your dreams about it ngl. Sample questions dbe but guarantee nai je 100% oikhane thekei common ashbe but yeah common ashe sample theke.
Lastly, finals er por uni onk weird kaaj korse. Like koyekjon ke curve korse and koyekjon ke kore nai. Like amr friend er B+ type er grade ashtesilo, oke smh A dse. And amr mid er result bhalo chilo and kinda A- type er result ashtesilo and i thought je ek grade tw curve korbe, but no brooo!!! Amk A- e dse and didn’t curve even a single grade. (I aced the finals Ik that). Jai hok uni jehetu JU r faculty er theke beshi expect o kori nah kichu.
Best part about his classes were he never gave a shit who attended it. Like if u wanna attend, you are his guest fs but if u don’t taile card punch kore chole jaite prba ( but don’t make it that obvious rki). Class e jodi kotha nah bolo, you are good to go for him.
Overall,
7/10 (biased curving er jonno) 
Bio201- NTA
Agei boli bhai, I got an A under her but that’s because she curved a lot. Pura semester, I was so pissed at her. She just cannot teach properly, at least according to me.I am a decent student, still I found it very irritating and pura semester onk pissed off hoisi. Her pronunciations are not good too. Uni class e jah bole oikhane theke question e dei, which are not in the slides. Like you have to do this whole ass tough course all on your own (at least I had to do so). I had to teach myself from the scratch, having no prior knowledge ab the stuffs. Uni question hard kore, but efforts dye slides porle para jay. Bonus exam nei uni structures and others kichu stuffs er upor but oitar jnno je syllabus thake bhai
 like who th in this world would study sm for three marks. Unar class e tmr unar chokher shmne ashte hbe, like she has to know u and recognise u at a glance and know all of your names. Shoja kothay bolle paa chatte hobe, only then she might curve u. Unar exams e uni jeta important bolbe jiboneo oikhane theke questions dbe nah, sample question thekeo dbe nah. The most peculiar jayga theke question krbe and will pretend je question onk easy korse. And there will be sets for all the exams. All in all onk tough ekta course eta and you have to be good at organic chem for this. Slides bhalo kore porte hbe and like kon jayga theke je questions krbe uni you can never predict that. Attendance is important cause attendance er extra marks ase eikhane. She also does biased marking, easily marks o dei nah copy te.But last e jeye Motamoti curve kore but that does not cover up for the pura semester er trauma.
Overall, 
7.5/10 (curve korse ei jonno)
Bus172- MWHB
One of the worst faculties I came across. Class e kicchu bujha jay nah, I could not understand anything. Being an all science student, stats niye idea o chilo nh. But bhalo dik hocche je uni slides poray nah and theories ekdom e dei nah. All u have to read is the book and do the maths from it. First mid prjnto is bed of roses, cause chapters gulao easy and uni question of book thekei kore just numbers change kore dei. But er pore jkhn shbai e bhalo korte thake, he switches it up and makes the questions tougher. Mid-2 theke baash dawa start kore using the excuse je dept theke bolse and tmader decurve kora lagbe and all. HE UNNECESSARILY YAPS A LOT BROOO. Like DUNIYA R SHOB AJAIRA KOTHA CLASS E BOLE LIKE BRAC E KIH HOISE, UIU TE KEMN KORE EXAM NEI AND STUFF (shunte chai nai bhai eigula). First er dke easy marking o kore and pore jeye ekta full stop and comma r jnno o number Kate emn type er. Attendance matters a lot, per class absence er jnno .25 katbe. And uni literally mukher upore bole decurve kore and sometimes he is rude too. Finals er question eto hard korailo bhai just for us to fumble our grades. And smh dept head shb kichu unakei bole and shb problems unar e face korte hoy. NSU r 25% A/A- er rule ke highlight kore uni eksho baar repeat krbe jinish pura semester e and will give a tough time for it.
One thing is uni exam e formula sheet niye jaite dei, so yeah formula memorise kora lage nah. So efforts kom dawa lagse ei course e but jodi question e tough kore then labh nai joto formula e thakuk nah ken amr shathe. And one bad thing about him is, he treats the student in an exam hall like suspect for any crime and he just doesn’t stop his yapping in the exams to that extent that you might even do your calculations wrong cause he was constantly talking and staring at your paper.
Curve mon chaile korteo pare, but amader ke decurve korse beshi so yeah.
Overall,
5/10 
Mat116- AVC
He is a new faculty and is very bhodro and soft spoken as a person. He is very sophisticated as a person. But unar porano bujha jay nah cause his teaching style is as if we know it all alr. He makes an easy concept very difficult and is accent is sometimes confusing. And the classes are boring too and maximum time ei card punch kore chole jaito shbai. Uni questions mostly slides thekei dei but unar slides o eto bujha r mto nah. Like u have to teach the whole content by yourself. Unar questions hard o hoy to some extent cause mostly graphs er upor ei course ta based. And if u are someone who is weak at maths and despise it, you are gonna hate it more. 3 ta assignments dbe of hugeeeeee credits like more than 60 marks and oikhane o marks Kate uni onk. Uni onk lenient faculty and tmk attendance and others stuff niye pera dbe nah but still exams e bhalo kora kothin.plus point books pora lage nah unar class e. He is nice overall but unar teaching style ta ektu better hoilei hbe. He curved a lottttttt this sem, idk why and how? Maybe pura section e struggle korte dilo dekhe ig. Like almost 3 grades curve korse uni ngl
Overall, 
7.5/10
Bio202l- SRS1
Decent faculty for lab. Shob e bujhay dei and he is friendly too. Viva nei nah kono and spot test o nai. Final er questions o easy kore but lab report niye ektu strict marking kore rki. Unar under lab e max 3-4 ta class korsi so it’s early to judge but jottuk bujhchi he is nice for doing labs under him.Decent amount of time o dei lab report likhar jonno. Questions lab manual, class lecture and class slides thekei dei and it’s easy too. Curving kore nah but deserving number e dbe uni.
Overall,
8.5/10
These reviews are fully personal and has no intention to hurt anyone’s favourite faculty or anyone’s sentiments. Different opinions thakte pare and I respect that too.
